title: Singing live with the band and Sinatra's aging voice
summary: Edison prefers live vocalists and praises how Sinatra, Ella and others adapt as their voices lower.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Working with Sinatra: bands, Vegas and the Sands

blocks.x: Oh, yeah. Sure it is. But he's one of these singers that -- you know, he wants to sing live with the band. Nowadays you put the voice on the tape and the musicians play -- that's not the business, to me. You know, the older singers, they want the band where they can hear it, where they can get with everybody, get the feeling, you know. There's a certain feeling that you get from the musicians when you're all together, than you're singing in the studio by yourself with the earphones on listening to the music. I don't know how a person can get the feeling that way.
Well, that's what you can hear on --
Oh, sure. You can hear all this music and it surrounds you, and the warmth from the musicians, the -- you get that emotional feeling from each other, you know, when it's live.
But 41, that's a lot of takes.
41's a lot of takes, believe me.
You'd think there would be a sort of tension building.

Yeah. And I still record with him. And he still wants it live, you know. But, you know, he can walk in a studio and after his first note, he can tell whether his chops are good, you know. And if his chops are no good, there's no date. Because he will not perform unless he feels good, unless he's -- and I can dig that. Oh, I'm for that 100 percent. Because if you're not at your best, why put it on a record.
That's right. Because, I mean, he can't -- how old is he now? He's about 60 --
I mean, you can't really expect his voice to be --
Well, no, but in the earlier years, you know, when we were recording, like in the '50s.
Well, yes, that's 20 years ago and there's a difference.

Oh, sure. But as you get older, your voice gets lower. But he's still one of the most dynamic performers that we have. Because it's not what you do with a song -- when you get to that phase in your life, it's what you can do with a song, you know. Your voice is not the same but the way you handle it. And you make allowances; where a note is too
high, you make allowances. You use your wisdom in that, you know. All the tricks in the bag through the years. And like him, Ella, the old singers, I just love them so much, you know.
Well, that's another generation, you know.
